name: foldseek-server
description: Search protein structures with Foldseek, align them with FoldMason, search 3D motifs with FoldDisco, and export results for analysis.

tools.name: get_shared_dir
tools.description: Report the verified local shared directory

tools.name: get_result_summary
tools.description: Bounded summary of a finished result

tools.name: export_result
tools.description: Write the complete result to files

tools.name: select_hits
tools.description: Name a set of hits for forwarding

tools.name: select_msa_columns
tools.description: Name alignment columns and derive their motif

tools.name: send_to
tools.description: Forward a hit or selection into a new job

base_url.title: Server URL
base_url.description: Foldseek Server deployment used for searches.

state_dir.title: State directory override
state_dir.description: Optional folder for cached results and selections. If empty, a .foldseek-server folder under the current user's home is used.

shared_dir.title: Shared folder override
shared_dir.description: Optional folder for exported results and imported structures. If empty, a foldseek-server-shared folder under the current user's home is used.
